content:
dmitri: FYI saw 95/99p latency bump for small embeddings requests (1-2 vectors, dims=1536).

maria: are they hitting splitter or fastpath?

dmitri: splitter; no X-Embed-Shape header present. batch_wait_ms spikes in traces.

alex: proposal: tiny-fastpath opt-in header `X-Embed-Shape: tiny` + runtime heuristic for SDKs. route only when queue <4.
sre-oncall: accounting risk. add `mini_fastpath_units` and `mini_fastpath_unit_delta` metrics. alert if delta >15% and p99 latency regresses.
zara: console card: mini-fastpath rate, p50/95/99 latencies, units delta. toggle to show high-volume tenants.
ops-bot: deploy started for router/tiny-fastpath -> canary 5%.
dmitri: capture `batch_fill_time_ms` and `router_decision` tag in traces.
maria: SDK PR exposes header off by default. rollout plan: internal canary -> 48-72h metrics -> wider.
alex: pseudo: if ((hdr=="tiny" || (count<=1 && dims<=2048)) && queue<4) route=TINY_FASTPATH; else DEFAULT;
sre-oncall: i'll add alerts once metrics names final. zara: i'll mock the dashboard. reconvene after canary. :thumbsup:
